senses.gloss: m. (סָנֵא = שָׂנֵא; cmp. קַנָּא a. קַנּוֹא) hater.—Pl. סַנּוֹאִין, סַנָּאִין.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 118b">Zeb. 118ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:16">Deut. XXXIII, 16</cite>, play on <cite ref="O01193"><he>סְנֶה</he></cite>) <he>עין … מן הס׳ שלו</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בין השנואין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the eye (of Joseph) which refused to enjoy that which was not its own, shall be permitted to feast on that which belongs to his haters (the brother tribes); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 29:2">Yalk. Josh. 29</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:12:4">Y. Meg. I, 72ᵈ</cite> top <he>ששרת שכינה בסַנָּאָיו של יוסף</he> the Divine Presence dwelt among Joseph’s haters.
